scientific_goal: Benchmark-specific SOTA objective, never a guaranteed outcome
forbidden: global driver paging or power changes
historical_gates: remain unchanged; new exploration criteria do not promote V17
hard_stop_conditions: fatal data/semantic integrity issue for dependent branch
soft_branch_status: NO_CANDIDATE does not stop other authorized families
replication_limit: One selected architecture family plus its predeclared controls; exact fit graph and budget recorded before training.
final_refit_limit: At most one final event candidate and one multimodal candidate; freeze graph, support and budget before start. Do not consume H/V as an evaluation afterward.
